title: Temperature Quantification at the Specimen for Side-entry Cryo-TEM Holders
content: In order to accommodate cryo-vitrification, side entry cooling became popular in the 1980s [1] and later led a revolution in structural biology [2]. These same stages have also enabled investigation of exotic phase transitions in electronic and quantum materials [3-6]. Recently, using electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS) of plasmons peaks, Kumar et al. showed that the temperature at the specimen is higher than reported values for side-entry cryo-TEM holders [7]. Here, we quantify this temperature difference near the sample for several commercially available cryogenic holders, measured using a custom high-vacuum ex situ setup.
